name: Mayuzumi Rin
source:
During a business trip, she becomes involved in the plane crash and, like Kokoro, is one of the survivors.

[spoiler]Uncooperative, she makes a point of standing in the way of the refugees, disturbing the unity of the group.[/spoiler]
